status: Specification only; no workflow, persistence or platform internals implemented
purpose: Convert a planned shot or shot sequence and bound sources into a separately reviewable video candidate

required_fields.identity: film_id, scene_id (nullable), shot_id, task_id, task_version; each identifier film-scoped
required_fields.plan: Declared/reconstructed/proposed status; planned boundaries and source evidence; one task may request multiple shots
required_fields.sources: Immutable film/asset/version bindings, raw role/path, reference IDs, source producer or unresolved state, scoped authority
required_fields.instructions: Separate subject action, camera action or static camera, environment motion, ordered/timed events, dialogue/voice/audio intent, exclusions, invariants and allowed changes; each with state, channel and evidence
required_fields.adapter: Literal model identifier/name, explicit version state, raw parameter document and parse state, controls with raw JSON types/units if declared; requested duration/aspect/resolution separate from controls
required_fields.provenance: Snapshot/source paths and evidence labels, exact source hashes, bounded excerpts, competing explanation, denominator and confidence
required_fields.result: Output asset/candidate IDs and explicit dependencies; unknown media verification, further-work use and review status separate
required_fields.review: Unknown/candidate/needs_review/approved/rejected; actor, scope, version and decision event required for approval/rejection

value_states.observed: Preserve raw value with channel/scope; false, zero and JSON null distinct

readiness_rules: Resolve required source bindings and conflicts with a human; no source inferred from a folder or date
Round-trip raw values; require an adapter declaration before translating units or asserting support
Keep written shot boundaries beside multi_shots=false; never silently rewrite either
Do not infer unseen media properties, quality, continuity or approval from a reference or reuse edge

revision_routes.inputs: Same immutable sources plus named changed action/camera/timing intent
revision_routes.behaviour: New task version and candidate; preserve prior request and invariants

revision_routes.inputs: Explicit revised source version, property delta and image producer link
revision_routes.behaviour: New bound input version; retain predecessor and proposed downstream review scope

revision_routes.inputs: Explicit video input plus allowed change region/properties and invariants
revision_routes.behaviour: New candidate; mask optional only if actually supplied; no defect inferred

revision_routes.inputs: Video source and declared direction/boundary context
revision_routes.behaviour: Keep source and requested continuation separately; no assumed source end-frame verification

revision_routes.inputs: Named source, proposed boundaries and per-shot constraints
revision_routes.behaviour: Human chooses changed decomposition; link tasks without claiming an executed cut

revision_routes.inputs: Explicit retry reason/actor, attempt cap and optional budget bound
revision_routes.behaviour: Record a new attempt under a human-defined policy; do not learn a cap or failure rate from this archive

guardrails: No automatic camera or identity change
No infinite retry; stop at declared cap, unresolved sources, unsupported adapter controls or ambiguous change/invariant scope
validation_tests: Synthetic two-film ID collision cannot bind cross-film source
False/null/absent/empty controls and requested timing survive round-trip
Human adjudication resolves written cuts/false flag without changing source record

Controlled experiment: same task/sources/model, one change (split versus continuous, camera revision or revised keyframe), predeclared repetitions/rubric/budget and explicit review events; no benefit claim before test
